notes.title: 08/06/2016 - Big Update 0.2.0 "Smaller Area Update"
notes.notes:
- We added ArmSwinger Natural VR Locomotion :
From the dev of ArmSwinger : "ArmSwinger allows you to use your arms to control your position in 3D space in a natural way with minimal disorientation or nausea."

- We added alternative small map for tower mode rebuilt for ArmSwinger Locomotion (no more platforms but wood planks and ladders).
ArmSwinger allows us to exploit roomscale in a new way. We invite you to test this locomotion system without platforms and without elevators in the new alternative map of tower mode.

- We added locomotion selection on the map
- We added tutorial for armswinger in tutorial room
- We removed little house for home teleport (now, we only use menu)
- We increased hitbox size for arrows spawner
- we added a quiver behind your head in survival mode
- We resolved some issues with axes 

Previous update :

- We added a new survival map - Melee exclusive 
- We added a new enemy : Melee Elite 
- We added "Survival III" icon on map 
- We added new difficulty for survival I & II 
- Life potion now restore full life 
- We solved an issue when you paring with sword 
- We added recoil animation when you touch skeleton with your sword 
- We added a new score page in your book for the new survival map 
- Minor bug fixes
